look_here_first: Relatively smooth leaves, strongly asymmetrical leaf base, unarmed tree habit, corky-warty bark.

lookalikes.differences: Compared with C. reticulata, sugarberry has thinner, smoother leaves with less prominently raised reticulate veins beneath. Compared with C. lindheimeri, leaf undersides are not densely white-tomentose.
